component.subject: Call to Worship
component.source: Psalm 150:1-2, Open English Bible, release 2025.6, CC0; "Hallelujah" rendered "Praise the Lord".

original.p: Psalm 150:1-2 (OEB 2025.6): Hallelujah. Praise God in his holy place. Praise him in the sky, his stronghold. Praise him for his deeds of power. Praise him for his boundless greatness.

p.line: Praise God in his holy place.
Praise him in the sky, his stronghold.
Praise him for his deeds of power.
Praise him for his boundless greatness.
